description: This file defines a Sass mixin named 'navbar-vertical-align' used to vertically align elements within a Bootstrap navbar by calculating the appropriate top and bottom margins based on the element height and the navbar height.

methods.name: navbar-vertical-align
methods.description: A Sass mixin that takes the element height as an argument and sets the 'margin-top' and 'margin-bottom' properties to vertically align the element within the navbar.
